description.value: Amigo Pancake House is a casual all-day breakfast and brunch restaurant in Port Coquitlam specializing in pancakes, waffles, omelettes, and classic diner fare. The menu spans more than 40 items including egg dishes, specialty omelettes, burgers, and sandwiches, with several vegetarian-friendly plates. It is a hearty, filling stop for cyclists exploring the Tri-Cities area.

address.value: 2228 McAllister Avenue, Unit 102, Port Coquitlam, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at amigopancake.ca is live, matches the OSM name and address, and confirms the business is actively operating with an online ordering system (Focal Eats). OSM tag takeaway=yes is corroborated by the website's online ordering flow. Vegetarian options are explicitly named in the menu (Veggie Special, Meatless, Vegetarian Omelette), but no bike infrastructure, washroom mentions, or other cyclist-specific amenities appear anywhere in the OSM tags or website content.
concerns: Phone number (604) 464-2040 is present on the website but absent from the OSM record; OSM could be updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible restaurant with a live website and online ordering. A real business useful to touring cyclists seeking a substantial breakfast or lunch stop.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly lists Veggie Special (eggs, avocado, hash brown), Meatless (eggs any style, hash brown, toast or pancakes), and Vegetarian Omelette (green pepper, onion, mushroom, spinach)

wow_evidence: casual all-day breakfast and brunch restaurant in Port Coquitlam
